summary: SPHINCS+ variant with 16-byte hashes and P = 0. A 184-bit message digest (the signer grinds ρ until its last 10 bits are zero) yields 14 FORS+C leaf indices and a 34-bit hypertree index. Six layers of WOTS target-sum signatures (42 chains, digit sum 186) and Merkle paths (heights 11,5,5,5,4,4) authenticate the FORS key to the 16-byte root. Keygen caches the height-11 top tree as masked nodes under a 256-bit MAC. Verification: a constant 13,371 cycles.

facts.label: Digest and FORS+C
facts.value: 184-bit digest = idx (34 b) ‖ u₀…u₁₃ (10 b each) ‖ 10 zero bits; 14 trees of height 10, 176 B each

facts.label: Hypertree
facts.value: 6 layers, heights 11,5,5,5,4,4 = 34-bit index; layer 5 signs the FORS key; layer 0 = cached top tree, root = pk

facts.label: WOTS encoding
facts.value: Target sum, w = 3: H(tw ‖ P ‖ M ‖ LE32 c) → 42 digits of 3 bits summing to 186; c < 2²², no checksum

facts.label: Keygen cache
facts.value: 128 KiB: 4,094 top-tree nodes (levels 0–10) each ⊕ a PRF mask + 256-bit MAC keyed by the seed

facts.label: Signing with the cache
facts.value: MAC check first; top path = 11 cache nodes ⊕ masks; layer 0 costs only leaf e₀'s 42 PRF + 186 chain steps

facts.label: Witness expansion
facts.value: Fixed byte permutation, W = 7,080 B: the 6 counters move to bytes 7,056–7,079 so all 16-byte items are 8-aligned

facts.label: Verification cost
facts.value: 13,371 cycles on every accepting run + ⌈7,080 / 256⌉ = 28 → C = 13,399; 850 HASH calls, 914 blocks

profile.method: 16 random keys and 32-byte messages (seeded PRNG): ref.py keygen (pk + cache), sign with the cache, expand on the emulator, verify traced on vm.py; all accepted at 13,371 cycles
